_readme: YOUR HOLDINGS - derived from your Midas and OKX screenshots on 2026-08-08.
quantity and buy_price were reconstructed from the value, current price and
profit-percentage each broker displayed. The arithmetic reproduces Midas's
stated total of $1,167.72 and -$71.36 (-5.76%) to the cent, and OKX's figures
were read after switching its display currency to USD, so no exchange-rate
buy_price is an AVERAGE across all your fills. Because you buy piecewise with
limit orders, that average is exactly what the broker's percentage already
encodes - so no per-order records are needed.
buy_date is absent on purpose: it cannot be recovered from a screenshot, and it
affects no profit or risk figure. It is optional.
